# civo

**Tag**: web, cli

## 简介

A command-line client and API access classes for civo.com

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.civo.com
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/absolutedevops/civo-ruby
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/absolutedevops/civo-ruby/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/civo
